prompts.materials: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production tactical RPG terrain material sheet. Primary request: create reusable 16x16 logical terrain textures for an original classic Fire Emblem Gaiden-like grid tactics game, matching a humble muted retro pixel art style. Flat orthographic top-down game surface textures, crisp pixels but gentle low contrast, limited olive green / muted lavender gray stone / old beige dirt / gray blue water / pale snow palette. Exact layout: 4 columns by 4 rows, all cells equally sized, no gaps, no frames, no writing, no perspective. Each cell is a large swatch of a seamlessly repeatable material, small sparse patterns intended to remain readable when sampled to 16 native pixels. Row 1: olive grass, pale snow with occasional violet pixels, packed tan dirt road, rough dark cave floor. Row 2: lavender stone paving, pale cobbled courtyard, weathered wood deck, gray blue deep water. Row 3: subtle shallow water, warm sandy ground, desaturated salt flat, muted marsh mud. Row 4: dense small forest canopy surface, jagged violet rock wall surface, aged plaster floor, mossy sacred stone floor. Avoid large objects, buildings, characters, black grid outlines, strong specular highlights, modern sharp bevels, gradients, photorealism, UI, text. All 16 material swatches fill their exact equal cells, surface only.
prompts.buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable transparent tactical RPG building and prop modules, not world map symbols. Primary request: a clean production sprite sheet for humble classic Fire Emblem Gaiden-style top-down grid battle maps. Handcrafted muted retro pixel art with limited olive / lavender-gray stone / old purple roofs / tan wood palette, slightly elevated overhead view, same very restrained gentle shading as an early 16-bit tactics game. Exact layout 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate complete objects centered in generous transparent equal slots, objects never touch slot borders, no text labels. Row1: small snowy cottage (2x2 tile footprint), grain storehouse with sacks visible (3x2), stone barracks (3x2), old tower entrance (2x3). Row2: fort gate doorway facing down (2x2), wooden palisade closed gate (2x1), opened wooden palisade gate (2x1), stone jail closed iron door (1x2). Row3: wagon laden with grain sacks (2x1), plain medicine wagon with covered crates (2x1), storage wooden crates (1x1), large grain sacks (1x1). Row4: simple iron brazier unlit (1x1), masonry sun altar with subdued aged brass emblem (2x2), old staircase up (2x2), old staircase down (2x2). True transparent background. Tiny sprites intended to be sampled to native 16 pixels per logical tile. Clear accessible entrances facing bottom. Preserve entire silhouettes with no detached stray pixels. No characters, no terrain backgrounds, no green-screen, no modern gloss, no isometric diamond bases, no heavy outlines, no black frames, no UI, no writing.
prompts.decor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable terrain and architecture module sprite sheet for classic Fire Emblem Gaiden level of tactical battle-map DETAIL. Primary request: sixteen detailed handmade retro pixel art map modules, restrained gentle palette olive forest, muted purple-gray masonry, dark cave rock, beige wood. Orthographic overhead tactical-game view, slight vertical visible front facades like classic 16-bit Fire Emblem battle maps. Exactly a 4 column by 4 row sheet, each distinct complete module centered in a generous separate transparent slot. No text, no UI, no writing. Row1: dense irregular pine forest patch with distinct tree crowns (3x3 tile module), dense snowy pine forest patch (3x3), tall continuous jagged rock face forming mountain ridge (4x2), cave rock face with dark entrance facing south (3x2). Row2: long fortress masonry north wall with battlements and visible facade (4x1), fortress west wall vertical with rough stone (1x4), fortress L outer northwest corner wall (2x2), fortress L inner southeast corner wall (2x2). Row3: wood fence north segment with posts and shadows (4x1), wood fence west segment (1x3), jail cell iron bars horizontal segment (3x1), jail cell bars vertical segment (1x3). Row4: mossy wall breached gap module (3x1), tiny white field flowers and grass tuft (1x1), scattered small purple-gray boulder pile (1x1), old stone well with bucket (1x1). Real transparent background, complete silhouettes. Consider these as game art to sample to 16px per native grid cell. Rich varied forms and weathered surfaces, NO plain grid-cell blocks, NO chessboard floor, NO icons with diamond bases, NO exaggerated highlights, NO photorealistic gradients.
prompts.generation: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight reusable transparent story props for a humble classic Fire Emblem Gaiden-like tactical grid game. Exact layout 4 columns by 2 rows, all 8 complete sprites centered in generous transparent slots with no touching, no writing or labels. Hand-painted retro pixel art, delicate restrained shading, muted olive / lavender-gray stone / aged brass / beige wood, top-down slightly elevated game view matching early 16-bit Fire Emblem battle-map props. Row1: simple gray grave headstone with unfinished blank inscription and small wildflowers (1x1 logical cell); upright wooden aid plaque with carved round sun and EXACTLY SEVEN distinct short feather rays in its crown, no words (1x2); small wooden case with rolled military orders and red sealing cord (1x1); small burning iron brazier with clearly warm amber flame (1x1). Row2: small white cloth surrender flag on a short wooden stake (1x1); humble clinic stone doorway facing south with hanging herb bundle, no modern medical cross (1x2); opened iron jail door with entire stone surround, open passage and intact hinges (1x2); small old masonry sunlight ritual lamp with a quiet pale gold glow and round brass sun emblem (1x2). These will be sampled to native 16 pixels per logical cell. Preserve complete silhouettes, simple readable tiny forms, and transparent alpha. NO terrain backdrop, NO photorealism, NO gradients across the background, NO modern glossy edges, NO characters, NO isometric diamond bases, NO UI.
prompts.seven_feather_edit: Edit only the aid plaque in row 1 column 2 of this eight-object sprite sheet. Replace its five-ray crown carving with a round sun surrounded by EXACTLY SEVEN separate short feather rays, evenly spaced around the full circle so all seven can be visibly counted. Make enough spacing between them. Keep the plank shape, perspective, pixel art style, color palette, slot layout, and every other object completely unchanged. Preserve the true transparent background; no words or extra objects.
